ddl:
CREATE TABLE customers (
  id NUMBER(10) NOT NULL,
  name VARCHAR2(100) NOT NULL,
  email VARCHAR2(150) NOT NULL,
  country_code VARCHAR2(2) NOT NULL,
  tier VARCHAR2(10) NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL,
  attrs JSON,
  PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE categories (
  id NUMBER(10) NOT NULL,
  parent_id NUMBER(10),
  name VARCHAR2(100) NOT NULL,
  depth NUMBER(10) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE products (
  id NUMBER(10) NOT NULL,
  category_id NUMBER(10) NOT NULL,
  sku VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL,
  name VARCHAR2(150) NOT NULL,
  description VARCHAR2(4000) NOT NULL,
  price NUMBER(12,2) NOT NULL,
  attrs JSON,
  active BOOLEAN NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES categories (id)
)

CREATE TABLE orders (
  id NUMBER(10) NOT NULL,
  customer_id NUMBER(10) NOT NULL,
  status VARCHAR2(12) NOT NULL,
  ordered_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL,
  total_amount NUMBER(14,2) NOT NULL,
  shipping_country VARCHAR2(2) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES customers (id)
)

CREATE TABLE order_items (
  id NUMBER(10) NOT NULL,
  order_id NUMBER(10) NOT NULL,
  product_id NUMBER(10) NOT NULL,
  qty NUMBER(10) NOT NULL,
  unit_price NUMBER(12,2) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES orders (id),
  FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products (id)
)

CREATE TABLE events (
  id NUMBER(19) NOT NULL,
  customer_id NUMBER(10) NOT NULL,
  event_type VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL,
  occurred_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL,
  payload JSON,
  value_num NUMBER(12,4) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE inventory (
  product_id NUMBER(10) NOT NULL,
  warehouse_id NUMBER(10) NOT NULL,
  qty NUMBER(10) NOT NULL,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (product_id, warehouse_id)
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_customers_email ON customers (email)
